k: the positive number of congruences and moduli
m_i: the i-th modulus; the moduli are integers greater than 1 and pairwise coprime
a_i: the prescribed integer residue modulo m_i
M_i: For each index i, the product M/m_i of all moduli except m_i.
P_r: The partial product m_1m_2...m_r used in the uniqueness induction.
N_i: the product of all m_j with j different from i
u_i: an integer Bézout coefficient for M_i and m_i
v_i: an integer Bézout coefficient for M_i and m_i
A_j: A Bézout coefficient satisfying A_jm_j+B_jm_{t+1}=1 in the uniqueness argument.
B_j: A Bézout coefficient satisfying A_jm_j+B_jm_{t+1}=1 in the uniqueness argument.
x: an integer satisfying all prescribed congruences
y: a second integer satisfying all prescribed congruences
p: a positive integer used in the proof of Bézout's identity
q: the integer quotient d/P_t in the induction
S: the set of positive integer linear combinations of p and q
c_i: an integer coefficient such that A_i m_i+c_i M_i=1
e_i: The selector integer s_i M_i, congruent to 1 modulo m_i and 0 modulo every other modulus.
r_ij: an integer Bézout coefficient multiplying m_j
s_ij: an integer Bézout coefficient multiplying m_i
n: a positive integer in the coprime-product lemma
t: an integer quotient in the two-factor divisibility argument
A: the product of the coefficients alpha_j
B: an integer collecting terms divisible by m_(r+1)
r: a positive integer used in an auxiliary Bézout or divisibility argument
s: a positive integer coprime to r in an auxiliary argument
h: the integer quotient q/m_{t+1} in the induction
rho: the nonnegative remainder in Euclidean division
r_{ij}: a Bezout coefficient multiplying m_i for the pair m_i,m_j
s_{ij}: a Bezout coefficient multiplying m_j for the pair m_i,m_j
A_i: an integer coefficient multiplying m_i in a Bezout identity for m_i and M_i
E_i: the integer c_iM_i, congruent to 1 modulo m_i and to 0 modulo every other modulus
u_{ij}: A Bézout coefficient multiplying m_j for the pair (m_j,m_i).
v_{ij}: A Bézout coefficient multiplying m_i for the pair (m_j,m_i).
s_i: The product of the coefficients u_{ij} over all j unequal to i.
t_i: An integer for which s_i M_i+t_i m_i=1.
z: The difference x-y of two simultaneous solutions.
